4.3.9.2 Cyclic Reception of Communication Data
[SWS_Rte_04657] The Cyclic Processing of the ComData ⌈If a ComData (system signal or system signal group) is mapped to a VariableDataPrototype (via RteComDataVariableDataPrototypeInstanceRef), RTE shall perform the complete read process within the cyclic function Rte_ComDataMainFunction of these ComData including:
• Check if a new data is received.
• Retrieve the data received from COM module for these ComData (Signal/SignalGroup). The data can be received by two ways:
– Using the stored data by Rte if the ComData is received data by Com Call-backs.
– Using Com Receive APIs (e.g. Com_ReceiveSignalGroup).
• Execute the inverse data transformation, if applicable.
⌋
Note: Rte_ComDataMainFunction can process multiple ComData (system signal or system signal group) according to The mapped RteComDataVariableDataPrototypeInstanceRef. Note: If the received VariableDataPrototype is not mapped to OsTask in RteComDataMapping (comHandlerTaskMappingEnabled is set to FALSE), then this mapped ComData (signals/signal groups) will be processed within the context of the upper layer (SWCs). If Cyclic Reception is enabled and an error happens during the processing of ComData, The RTE API Rte_Read returns the stored last value. In order to handle communication jitter within a correct sequence for E2E transformer calls the polling for received data has to be configured faster than the sending cycle (oversampling).
[SWS_Rte_04658] Check for no data received from COM where E2E transformation is configured ⌈The Rte Read Api (Rte_Read) shall return RTE_E_NO_NEW_DATA if:
• RteComDataE2EXfOverSamplingPeriod is configured. AND
• returnNoNewDataEnabled is set to TRUE. AND
• E2E transformation is configured for this data. AND
• Last execution of RTE cycle function Rte_ComDataMainFunction before this Rte_Read call didn’t receive new data from COM within the configured RteComDataE2EXfOverSamplingPeriod.
⌋
